originalResearchStudies.title: Local LLM Inference Memory Overhead: Ollama vs vLLM on Consumer Hardware
originalResearchStudies.methodology: Measured cold boot RAM, active VRAM, and tokens-per-second over 1,000 requests using Llama-3.3-8B-Instruct on an Apple M3 Max (36GB) and Linux Ubuntu (RTX 4090 24GB).
transparentLimitations: Benchmarks restricted to single-user local inference; does not model multi-tenant distributed cloud clusters.
Token generation speeds vary based on prompt context length and quantization format (Q4_K_M vs FP16).
